smart-2.note: Rear-wheel drive only ('ausschliesslich Hinterradantrieb', like the fortwo). World premiere Paris Oct 2026, deliveries from Q2 2027; ch.smart.com already shows the 999-unit #2 Couture Edition.

smart-1.note: RWD on Pro/Pro+/Premium (single rear motor); dual-motor AWD only on #1 Pulse and #1 BRABUS.

smart-3.note: RWD on Pro/Pro+/Premium; dual-motor AWD (one motor per axle, 315 kW) on #3 BRABUS (and Pulse/anniversary editions where offered).

mercedes-benz-a-class.note: FWD on A 180/A 200/A 250 e and diesels; 4MATIC on A 220 4MATIC, A 250 4MATIC, AMG A 35 4MATIC and AMG A 45 S 4MATIC+ (Swiss price list). Swiss site now lists only the hatchback.

mercedes-benz-cla.note: Electric CLA 200/250/250+ are RWD ('Hinterradantrieb'), CLA 350 4MATIC electric is AWD; hybrid CLA 180/200/220 are FWD ('Vorderradantrieb'), CLA 200 4MATIC and CLA 220 4MATIC hybrid are AWD. Same split for the Shooting Brake.

mercedes-benz-gla.note: New electric GLA: GLA 200 and 250+ RWD, GLA 350 4MATIC AWD (orders from 30 Jul 2026). FWD only on the outgoing H247 (GLA 180/200/250 e, runout) and on the new hybrid GLA due early 2027 (FWD or 4MATIC). H247 4MATIC: GLA 220 d/250 4MATIC, AMG GLA 35/45 S.

mercedes-benz-glb.note: Electric GLB 250+ RWD ('Hinterradantrieb'), GLB 350 4MATIC AWD; hybrid GLB 200/220 FWD ('Vorderradantrieb'), GLB 200/220 4MATIC AWD (Swiss pages). Outgoing X247 (GLB 250 4MATIC, AMG GLB 35) in runout.

mercedes-benz-c-class.note: RWD on C 200, C 250, C 300, C 200 d/C 250 d, C 300 e ('Hinterradantrieb'); 4MATIC on C 250 4MATIC, C 250 d 4MATIC, C 300 e/C 400 e 4MATIC; All-Terrain and AMG C 43/C 63 are 4MATIC only; electric C-Class with EQ Technology also listed in CH (dual-motor 4MATIC at launch).

mercedes-benz-glc.note: All combustion and plug-in GLC / GLC Coupé are 4MATIC only ('Allradantrieb' on every variant in CH). Only 2WD version: the electric GLC 250 (single rear motor, 260 kW); electric GLC 300 4MATIC and GLC 400 4MATIC are dual motor.

smart-5.note: RWD on Pro, Pro+ and Premium; dual-motor AWD ('Allrad') on Pulse, Summit Edition and BRABUS.

mercedes-benz-amg-gt-4-door-coupe.note: AWD only: AMG GT 53 ('Antriebsart: Allradantrieb', 400 kW) and the more powerful GT 55 / GT 63 (AMG.EA axial-flux motors).

mercedes-benz-e-class.note: RWD on E 200 and E 200 d ('Hinterradantrieb'); 4MATIC on E 200 4MATIC, E 220 d/E 450 d 4MATIC, E 450 4MATIC and all plug-in hybrids in CH (E 300 e/E 300 de/E 400 e 4MATIC); All-Terrain and AMG E 53 HYBRID are 4MATIC only.

mercedes-benz-eqe.note: RWD on EQE 300 and EQE 350+ ('Hinterradantrieb'); EQE 350 4MATIC, EQE 500 4MATIC and AMG EQE 53 4MATIC+ are AWD. Runout.

mercedes-benz-eqs.note: RWD on EQS 400 and EQS 450+ ('Hinterradantrieb'); EQS 500 4MATIC and EQS 580 4MATIC ('Allradantrieb') and AMG EQS 53 4MATIC+ are AWD.

mercedes-benz-s-class.note: Swiss line-up is 4MATIC except the S 450 e plug-in hybrid ('Hinterradantrieb'): S 350 d/450 d 4MATIC, S 450/500/580 4MATIC, S 580 e 4MATIC, AMG S 63 E PERFORMANCE 4MATIC+ and Mercedes-Maybach S-Class all AWD.

mercedes-benz-amg-gt-suv.note: AWD only: electric Mercedes-AMG GT 53 SUV (400 kW / 544 PS, 'Antriebsart: Allradantrieb'; CH from CHF 114,900).

mercedes-benz-eqe-suv.note: RWD on the single-motor EQE 350+ SUV ('Hinterradantrieb'); EQE 350 4MATIC, EQE 500 4MATIC and AMG EQE 53 4MATIC+ SUV are AWD ('Allradantrieb').

mercedes-benz-eqs-suv.note: AWD only: EQS 450 4MATIC, EQS 500 4MATIC, EQS 580 4MATIC SUV ('Antriebsart: Allradantrieb') and Mercedes-Maybach EQS 680 SUV; no RWD EQS 450+ SUV in CH.

mercedes-benz-gle.note: AWD only: every GLE and GLE Coupé is 4MATIC ('Antriebsart: Allradantrieb' for GLE 350 d/450 d, 450 e, 450, 580 4MATIC); AMG GLE 53/63 4MATIC+.

mercedes-benz-gls.note: All versions 4MATIC (GLS 450/580 4MATIC, GLS 350 d/450 d 4MATIC, AMG GLS 63 4MATIC+, Mercedes-Maybach GLS 600 4MATIC); Swiss price list.

mercedes-benz-g-class.note: Permanent all-wheel drive on every version: G 450 d, G 500 and AMG G 63 with low range and three 100% differential locks; G 580 with EQ Technology has four individually controlled electric motors.

mercedes-benz-amg-gt.note: RWD only on the 4-cylinder AMG GT 43 Coupé ('Hinterradantrieb'; listed in DE, not in the Swiss selector); GT 55/GT 63/GT 63 PRO 4MATIC+ and GT 63 S E PERFORMANCE are AWD ('AMG Performance 4MATIC+ Allradantrieb', with drift mode).

mercedes-benz-cle.note: RWD on CLE 180, CLE 200 and CLE 220 d (Germany, 'Hinterradantrieb'); CLE 200 4MATIC and AMG CLE 53 4MATIC+ are AWD. The Swiss site lists only the CLE 200 4MATIC (plus AMG CLE 53), so in CH it is effectively AWD-only.

mercedes-benz-sl.note: RWD only on the Mercedes-AMG SL 43 ('Antriebsart: Hinterradantrieb'); SL 55 4MATIC+, SL 63 4MATIC+, SL 63 S E PERFORMANCE and Mercedes-Maybach SL 680 Monogram Series are AWD.

mercedes-benz-b-class.note: Runout: gone from the Swiss site; the German page still shows the B 250 e (FWD plug-in hybrid) and advertises 'sogar Allradantrieb 4MATIC' (B 220 4MATIC). Others (B 180/B 200, diesels) FWD.

mercedes-benz-v-class.note: V-Class, Marco Polo/Marco Polo Horizon and diesel Vito Tourer are RWD with optional 4MATIC; FWD only on the electric eVito Tourer (front motor), which mercedes-benz.ch still lists. Drop FWD if the eVito Tourer is not counted in this tile.

mercedes-benz-vle.note: VLE 300 (203 kW, single motor) is front-wheel drive ('Vorderradantrieb'); VLE 400 4MATIC (310 kW, dual motor) is AWD ('Allradantrieb'). Both also as 'bis 3.5t' versions.

mercedes-benz-vito.note: Diesel Vito panel van/Mixto RWD with optional 4MATIC; electric eVito panel van is FWD (front motor). Both still listed on mercedes-benz.ch.

mercedes-benz-sprinter.note: RWD standard (diesel Sprinter and eSprinter); diesel Sprinter 4x4 (selectable AWD, optional low range) for panel van/chassis; FWD Sprinter dropped in Europe in 2024. Swiss site lists Sprinter (incl. Tourer) and eSprinter; 4x4 not verified on a page.

mazda-mazda2-hybrid.note: FWD only (Toyota Yaris hybrid twin; no AWD-i).

mazda-mazda3.note: FWD standard; AWD only with the e-Skyactiv X (automatic) in markets such as CH/DE. If Mazda has dropped e-Skyactiv X in Europe, the Mazda3 is FWD-only. mazda.ch / mazda.de not fetchable, unverified.

mazda-cx-30.note: FWD standard; i-ACTIV AWD optional (automatic) on selected e-Skyactiv engines, mainly in CH and other alpine markets. mazda.ch / mazda.de not fetchable, unverified.

mazda-cx-5.note: New CX-5 with 2.5 e-Skyactiv G (141 PS, automatic) offered as 2WD (FWD) or AWD. Not verified on a manufacturer page (web budget exhausted).

mazda-mazda-6e.note: Single rear motor (68.8 kWh 190 kW or 80 kWh Long Range 180 kW); no AWD in Europe. Not verified on a manufacturer page (web budget exhausted).

mazda-cx-60.note: RWD on e-Skyactiv D 200; AWD on e-Skyactiv D 254 and the e-Skyactiv PHEV. Not verified on a manufacturer page (web budget exhausted).

mazda-cx-6e.note: Single rear motor (EZ-60/Deepal S07 platform, 'motor placed at the rear'); no AWD announced for Europe (launched Brussels Jan 2026). Mazda sites not fetchable.

mazda-cx-80.note: AWD only in Europe (e-Skyactiv D 254 AWD and e-Skyactiv PHEV AWD). Not verified on a manufacturer page (web budget exhausted).

xpeng-l03.note: BEV: RWD Standard/Long Range (180 kW rear motor), AWD Performance and AWD Performance Ultra (dual motor, 285 kW). Range extender: single rear motor (RWD). First European deliveries Oct 2026.

xpeng-g6.note: Facelifted G6 launched in Europe (June 2025) as RWD Standard Range and RWD Long Range; dual-motor AWD Performance (358 kW) announced for later and sold in export markets (pre-facelift European G6 also had AWD Performance). Confirm the AWD is orderable in CH/DE; xpeng.com not fetchable.

xpeng-g9.note: RWD Standard Range and RWD Long Range ('Hecktriebler'); AWD Performance (dual motor, 405 kW). Line-up kept for the 2025 update. xpeng.com not fetchable.

xpeng-p7-plus.note: Single rear motor only (180 kW or 230 kW); no dual-motor/AWD version (applies to BEV and range-extender; 2026 facelift built by Magna Steyr in Graz). xpeng.com not fetchable.

xpeng-g9l.note: RWD Long Range Ultra (7 seats, 270 kW); AWD Performance Ultra (6 or 7 seats, 430 kW). Orders opened Oct 2026 (DE from EUR 74,600).

xpeng-x9.note: Unusual layout: the single-motor X9 drives the FRONT axle (export version 255 kW); dual-motor AWD version (export 395 kW) added with the 2026 model year. Exact European line-up not confirmed (xpeng.com not fetchable).

suzuki-swift.note: 1.2 Dualjet Hybrid: FWD standard (e.g. Unico 5MT, CHF 19,990); ALLGRIP AUTO 4x4 optional, standard on the Swiss 'Piz Sulai' trims ('serienmässiger Allradantrieb').

suzuki-vitara.note: ALLGRIP SELECT 4x4 (four modes) on mild and full hybrid; Swiss site shows only '1.4 Turbo Benzin ALLGRIP 4x4' versions, 2WD (FWD) versions are sold in other European markets (e.g. Germany).

suzuki-e-vitara.note: 2WD (front motor) with 49 or 61 kWh (e.g. Unico 2WD 49 kWh, CHF 31,990); dual-motor ALLGRIP-e AWD ('elektrisches Allradsystem AllGrip-e') with 61 kWh.

suzuki-across.note: New Across (RAV4-based PHEV, 2.5 petrol) has electric all-wheel drive 'E-Four' with TRAIL mode; no FWD version mentioned by Suzuki Schweiz.

suzuki-s-cross.note: FWD (2WD) standard; ALLGRIP SELECT 4x4 optional on the 1.4 mild hybrid and the 1.5 full hybrid (in CH mostly sold as 4x4). Not verified on a manufacturer page (web budget exhausted).

iveco-ejolly.note: FWD only (Stellantis electric mid-size van with Iveco badge); no factory 4x4.

iveco-daily.note: Daily van/chassis cab, CNG and eDaily are RWD; the diesel Daily 4x4 (off-road chassis cab with low range and locking differentials) is sold under the Daily name. Not verified on iveco.com.

iveco-esuperjolly.note: FWD only (Stellantis large electric van, Ducato body); no factory 4x4.

bugatti-tourbillon.note: V16 (Cosworth, 8.3 l) plus three electric motors, two on the front axle and one at the rear: mid-engine all-wheel drive. 250 units; bugatti.com not fetchable.

rimac-nevera.note: Four motors, one driving each wheel ('individual-wheel drive' with torque vectoring); same for Nevera R.
